title: ZeroJsCTAParameterIntegrityPatternSchema
Zero-JS WhatsApp CTA Parameter Integrity Pattern
source: EXP-029-001 (Andes Retreat Phase 32 Form Interaction Audit)
observation: Static HTML forms with action pointing to external messaging endpoints (e.g. WhatsApp wa.me) require pre-filled URI query parameters or explicit client JS encoding to avoid submitting empty destination strings.
rootCause: Unbound static form action attribute lacking URI query string defaults.
reusableRule: When building Zero-JS messaging form CTAs, pre-encode default contextual query strings (e.g. ?text=Hola%2C%20quisiera%20consultar...) to preserve 0 JS client runtime while guaranteeing messaging transmission integrity.
verificationCriterion: Inspecting form action attribute confirming non-empty pre-filled URI parameters.
